prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Australian woman — the personification of Sydney — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Sydney as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Sydney with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht
Season: spring — September to November, warming days with sudden swings of weather and the jacaranda trees blooming violet.
Time of day: the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work; fresh low sunlight, long cool shadows.
Outfit: a satin slip dress above the knee with sheer tights and ankle boots — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: chest-deep in the water.
SUPPORT: the water holds her up to the chest.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand tucks hair behind her ear.
LEFT HAND: her own left fingertips trail across the water surface.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

qa.anatomy: One arm reaches toward the hair while the other rests in the water.
observations: The slip and yacht are legible. The waterline naturally hides lower-body details.

acceptance: User selected candidate 1 and authorized fast-forward integration into main.
